votes.sql:
SELECT e.Fname,
       e.Minit,
       e.Lname,
       e.Salary * 0.8 AS Salary_GBP
FROM employee e
JOIN (
    SELECT Dno,
           AVG(Salary) AS median_salary
    FROM (
        SELECT e2.Dno,
               e2.Salary,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e2.Dno ORDER BY e2.Salary) AS rn,
               COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY e2.Dno) AS cnt
        FROM employee e2
    ) sub
    WHERE rn = (cnt + 1) / 2 OR rn = (cnt + 2) / 2
    GROUP BY Dno
) med ON e.Dno = med.Dno
WHERE e.Salary > med.median_salary;

           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY e.Dno) AS cnt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.Dno ORDER BY e.Salary) AS rn
    FROM employee e

median_dept AS (
    SELECT Dno,
           CASE
               WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
                   MAX(CASE WHEN rn = (cnt + 1) / 2 THEN Salary END)
               ELSE
                   (MAX(CASE WHEN rn = cnt / 2 THEN Salary END) + MAX(CASE WHEN rn = cnt / 2 + 1 THEN Salary END)) / 2.0
           END AS median_salary
    FROM dept_salaries
    GROUP BY Dno
)

WITH dept_avg AS (
    SELECT Dno AS dept_id, AVG(Salary) AS avg_salary
    FROM employee
    GROUP BY Dno
), qualified AS (
    SELECT e.*, d.Dname
    FROM employee e
    JOIN dept_avg a ON e.Dno = a.dept_id
    JOIN department d ON e.Dno = d.Dnumber
    WHERE e.Salary >= 1.2 * a.avg_salary
), dept_counts AS (
    SELECT Dno, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM qualified
    GROUP BY Dno
), dept_ranks AS (
    SELECT Dno, cnt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS dept_rank
    FROM dept_counts
)
SELECT q.Dname,
       q.Fname || ' ' || COALESCE(q.Minit, '') || ' ' || q.Lname AS employee_name,
       q.Salary * 0.85 AS salary_eur,
       r.dept_rank
FROM qualified q
JOIN dept_ranks r ON q.Dno = r.Dno
ORDER BY r.dept_rank, q.Dname, employee_name;

WITH dept_avg AS (
    SELECT Dno, AVG(CAST(Salary AS REAL)) AS avg_salary
    FROM employee
    GROUP BY Dno
),
qualified_employees AS (
    SELECT e.Fname, e.Lname, e.Dno, CAST(e.Salary * 0.85 AS REAL) AS salary_euros
    FROM employee e
    INNER JOIN dept_avg da ON e.Dno = da.Dno
    WHERE e.Salary >= da.avg_salary * 1.2
),
dept_counts AS (
    SELECT Dno, COUNT(*) AS emp_count
    FROM qualified_employees
    GROUP BY Dno
)
SELECT qe.Fname, qe.Lname, qe.salary_euros, qe.Dno
FROM qualified_employees qe
INNER JOIN dept_counts dc ON qe.Dno = dc.Dno
ORDER BY dc.emp_count DESC, qe.Dno, qe.Fname, qe.Lname;

votes.sql:
WITH emp_stats AS (
    SELECT e.*, 
           (julianday('now') - julianday(e.Bdate))/365.25 AS tenure,
           percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY e.Dno ORDER BY e.Salary DESC) AS salary_pr
    FROM employee e
), dept_avg AS (
    SELECT Dno, AVG((julianday('now') - julianday(Bdate))/365.25) AS avg_tenure
    FROM employee
    GROUP BY Dno
)
SELECT e.Ssn, e.Fname, e.Minit, e.Lname
FROM emp_stats e
JOIN dept_avg d ON e.Dno = d.Dno
WHERE e.tenure > d.avg_tenure
  AND e.salary_pr >= 0.75;

WITH department_salary_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        e.Fname,
        e.Lname,
        e.Dno,
        e.Bdate,
        e.Salary,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.Dno ORDER BY e.Salary DESC) AS salary_percentile,
        CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(e.Bdate)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS experience_years
    FROM employee e
)
SELECT 
    Fname,
    Lname
FROM department_salary_ranking
WHERE salary_percentile >= 0.5
AND experience_years >= 20

SELECT ROUND(SUM(
    (e.Salary - (
        CASE
            WHEN e.Salary <= 30000 THEN e.Salary * 0.10
            WHEN e.Salary <= 50000 THEN 30000 * 0.10 + (e.Salary - 30000) * 0.20
            ELSE 30000 * 0.10 + (50000 - 30000) * 0.20 + (e.Salary - 50000) * 0.30
        END)
    )) * w.Hours,
    2) * 0.92 AS total_after_tax_cost_eur
FROM employee e
JOIN works_on w ON e.Ssn = w.Essn
JOIN project p ON w.Pno = p.Pnumber
GROUP BY p.Pnumber;

WITH project_costs AS (
    SELECT 
        p.Pnumber,
        SUM(e.Salary * wo.Hours / 2080.0) AS gross_cost_usd
    FROM project p
    JOIN works_on wo ON p.Pnumber = wo.Pno
    JOIN employee e ON wo.Essn = e.Ssn

FROM project_costs;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Dno ORDER BY Salary DESC) AS rn
    FROM employee
)
SELECT 
    (Fname || ' ' || Minit || ' ' || Lname) AS name,
    Dno AS department_number,
    ROUND(Salary * 0.85, 2) AS salary_eur
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY Dno, rn;

WITH emp_scores AS (
    SELECT e.Ssn,
           e.Fname,
           e.Minit,
           e.Lname,
           d.Dname,
           SUM(w.Hours) AS total_hours,
           COUNT(DISTINCT w.Pno) AS project_cnt,
           SUM(w.Hours) * COUNT(DISTINCT w.Pno) AS score
    FROM employee e
    JOIN works_on w ON e.Ssn = w.Essn
    JOIN department d ON e.Dno = d.Dnumber
    GROUP BY e.Ssn, e.Fname, e.Minit, e.Lname, d.Dname
)
SELECT (e.Fname || ' ' || COALESCE(e.Minit || ' ', '') || e.Lname) AS name,
       e.Dname AS department,
       e.score
FROM emp_scores e
WHERE e.score = (SELECT MAX(score) FROM emp_scores)
ORDER BY e.score DESC;

WITH emp_stats AS (
    SELECT
        e.Ssn,
        e.Fname,
        e.Minit,
        e.Lname,
        e.Dno,
        COALESCE(SUM(w.Hours), 0) AS total_hours,
        COUNT(DISTINCT w.Pno) AS project_count,
        (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', e.Bdate)) AS years_at_company
    FROM employee e
    LEFT JOIN works_on w ON e.Ssn = w.Essn
    GROUP BY e.Ssn, e.Fname, e.Minit, e.Lname, e.Dno
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        Ssn,
        Fname || ' ' || COALESCE(Minit, '') || ' ' || Lname AS full_name,
        Dno,
        (total_hours * project_count + years_at_company) AS productivity_score
    FROM emp_stats
)
SELECT
    s.full_name AS employee_name,
    d.Dname AS department_name
FROM scored s
JOIN department d ON s.Dno = d.Dnumber
ORDER BY s.productivity_score DESC;

WITH emp_age AS (
    SELECT
        Ssn,
        (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Bdate) -
         (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', Bdate))) AS age
    FROM employee
),
emp_dep AS (
    SELECT
        Essn,
        COUNT(*) AS dep_count
    FROM dependent
    GROUP BY Essn
),
em_cost AS (
    SELECT
        e.Ssn,
        e.Dno,
        1000 +
        COALESCE(d.dep_count, 0) * 500 +
        CASE WHEN a.age >= 50 THEN 200 ELSE 0 END AS emp_cost
    FROM employee e
    LEFT JOIN emp_dep d ON e.Ssn = d.Essn
    JOIN emp_age a ON e.Ssn = a.Ssn
),
dept_cost AS (
    SELECT
        d.Dname,
        SUM(ec.emp_cost) AS dept_cost
    FROM emp_cost ec
    JOIN department d ON ec.Dno = d.Dnumber
    GROUP BY d.Dname
),
median_cost AS (
    SELECT AVG(cost) AS median_val
    FROM (
        SELECT dept_cost AS cost
        FROM dept_cost
        ORDER BY dept_cost
        LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dept_cost) % 2
        OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(*) - 1) / 2 FROM dept_cost)
    )
)
SELECT
    dc.Dname,
    dc.dept_cost AS healthcare_cost,
    CASE WHEN dc.dept_cost > mc.median_val THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS above_median_flag
FROM dept_cost dc
CROSS JOIN median_cost mc;

SELECT e.Ssn,
       CASE 
         WHEN IFNULL(SUM(w.Hours), 0) >= 40 THEN 'Gold'
         WHEN IFNULL(SUM(w.Hours), 0) >= 20 THEN 'Silver'
         ELSE 'Bronze'
       END AS tier
FROM employee e
LEFT JOIN works_on w ON e.Ssn = w.Essn
GROUP BY e.Ssn;

SELECT e.Fname, e.Lname, 
       CASE 
           WHEN COALESCE(SUM(w.Hours), 0) >= 100 THEN 'Gold'
           WHEN COALESCE(SUM(w.Hours), 0) >= 50 THEN 'Silver'
           ELSE 'Bronze'
       END AS performance_tier
FROM employee e
LEFT JOIN works_on w ON e.Ssn = w.Essn
GROUP BY e.Ssn;

WITH supervisors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Super_ssn AS Ssn
    FROM employee
    WHERE Super_ssn IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.Dname,
       (CASE WHEN stats.total > 0 THEN CAST(stats.senior_count AS REAL) / stats.total ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM (
    SELECT e.Dno AS dept_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.Ssn IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS senior_count
    FROM employee e
    LEFT JOIN supervisors s ON e.Ssn = s.Ssn

votes.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT Ssn, Super_ssn, 0 AS depth
    FROM employee
    WHERE Super_ssn IS NULL OR Super_ssn = ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.Ssn, e.Super_ssn, h.depth + 1
    FROM employee e
    JOIN hierarchy h ON e.Super_ssn = h.Ssn
),
salary_stats AS (
    SELECT
        e.Ssn,
        ( (RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.Dno ORDER BY e.Salary) - 1) * 1.0) /
        NULLIF((COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY e.Dno) - 1), 0) AS salary_percentile
    FROM employee e
),
workload AS (
    SELECT Essn AS Ssn,
           COALESCE(SUM(Hours), 0) AS total_hours
    FROM works_on
    GROUP BY Essn
)
SELECT
    e.Fname || ' ' || e.Lname AS employee_name,
    h.depth,
    s.salary_percentile,
    w.total_hours,
    CASE
        WHEN h.depth = 0 AND s.salary_percentile >= 0.75 AND w.total_hours >= 30 THEN 'High'
        WHEN h.depth <= 1 AND s.salary_percentile >= 0.5 AND w.total_hours >= 20 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS "Organizational Impact Tier"
FROM employee e
JOIN hierarchy h ON e.Ssn = h.Ssn
JOIN salary_stats s ON e.Ssn = s.Ssn
JOIN workload w ON e.Ssn = w.Ssn
ORDER BY e.Ssn;

WITH RECURSIVE EmployeeHierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        e.Ssn,
        e.Fname,
        e.Lname,
        e.Salary,
        e.Dno,
        e.Super_ssn,
        CASE WHEN e.Super_ssn IS NULL OR e.Super_ssn = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as depth
    FROM employee e
    WHERE e.Super_ssn IS NULL OR e.Super_ssn = ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        e.Ssn,
        e.Fname,
        e.Lname,
        e.Salary,
        e.Dno,
        e.Super_ssn,
        eh.depth + 1
    FROM employee e
    INNER JOIN EmployeeHierarchy eh ON e.Super_ssn = eh.Ssn
),
EmployeeDeptStats AS (
    SELECT 
        eh.Ssn,
        eh.Fname,
        eh.Lname,
        eh.Salary,
        eh.Dno,
        eh.depth,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY eh.Dno ORDER BY eh.Salary) as salary_percentile
    FROM EmployeeHierarchy eh
),
EmployeeWorkload AS (
    SELECT 
        w.Essn,
        SUM(COALESCE(w.Hours, 0)) as total_hours
    FROM works_on w
    GROUP BY w.Essn
),
CombinedMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        eds.Ssn,
        eds.Fname || ' ' || eds.Lname as employee_name,
        eds.depth as hierarchical_depth,
        ROUND(eds.salary_percentile * 100, 2) as salary_percentile,
        COALESCE(ewl.total_hours, 0) as project_workload,
        ((eds.depth / 5.0) * 30 + (eds.salary_percentile * 40 + (COALESCE(ewl.total_hours, 0) / 160.0) * 40)) as impact_score
    FROM EmployeeDeptStats eds
    LEFT JOIN EmployeeWorkload ewl ON eds.Ssn = ewl.Essn
)
SELECT 
    employee_name,
    CASE 
        WHEN impact_score >= 70 THEN 'Tier 1'
        WHEN impact_score >= 50 THEN 'Tier 2'
        WHEN impact_score >= 30 THEN 'Tier 3'
        ELSE 'Tier 4'
    END as Organizational_Impact_Tier
FROM CombinedMetrics;

WITH hierarchy AS (
    SELECT Ssn, Super_ssn, 0 AS depth FROM employee WHERE Super_ssn IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.Ssn, e.Super_ssn, h.depth + 1
    FROM employee e
    JOIN hierarchy h ON e.Super_ssn = h.Ssn
),
emp_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT Ssn, MAX(depth) AS hierarchical_depth
    FROM hierarchy
    GROUP BY Ssn
),
compensation AS (
    SELECT Ssn,
           PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Dno ORDER BY Salary) AS compensation_percentile
    FROM employee
),
workload AS (
    SELECT Essn AS Ssn,
           SUM(Hours) AS cumulative_project_workload
    FROM works_on
    GROUP BY Essn
)
SELECT e.Ssn,
       eh.hierarchical_depth,
       c.compensation_percentile,
       w.cumulative_project_workload
FROM employee e
LEFT JOIN emp_hierarchy eh ON e.Ssn = eh.Ssn
LEFT JOIN compensation c ON e.Ssn = c.Ssn
LEFT JOIN workload w ON e.Ssn = w.Ssn;
